card.name: Counting words like two, one, twice
card.fires_on: Words that express a small count or number of parts, such as twice, one side, two-legged, 4-point and quadriparesis, usually just before the thing being counted.

modes.label: Twice or one
modes.description: Frequency or side words such as twice, one, day after a count.

modes.label: Number-hyphen compounds
modes.description: Hyphenated or compound forms carrying a small number, such as -point or -legged.

modes.label: Quadri- words
modes.description: Partway through the word quadriparesis, which means four limbs.

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that mean a count of one or two, such as single and two, and away from unrelated words.
card.plain: It notices small-number words like twice, one side or two-legged.
